==== Public High Court ====
This is the court which represents the government when the government is sued by the people. This court also has ultimate jurisdiction over civilian laws, so if the argumentation over certain laws becomes intense this is the court which presides over such matters and interprets the law. Additionally, if any new laws are passed, it must be approved by the court. If laws are discontinued, it must also be approved by this court. 

==== Supreme Constitutional Court ====
This can be the court which deals with the constitutionality of new laws. It also helps to prosecute internal government court matters. For example, if corruption occurs, then this will be the court which acts as the judge against the government. Additionally, it aids in the interpretation of the constitution, and if any amendments are made to the constitution it must be unanimously approved by this court along with the rest of the upper house, lower house, and executor office.
